content: I will write a PowerShell script to search the untruncated transcript log for the last version of `app.js` so we can restore the overwritten sections.

# Read transcript line by line and find content
$lines = Get-Content -Path $logPath
Write-Host "Total lines in log: $($lines.Count)"

# We want to find tool calls related to app.js, especially write_to_file or replace_file_content
# Or any read_file/view_file outputs of app.js.
# Let's search for "app.js" in the lines.
$matchCount = 0
for ($i = $lines.Count - 1; $i -ge 0; $i--) {
    $line = $lines[$i]
    if ($line -like "*app.js*") {
        Write-Host "Found match at line $i"
        # Let's save the first 5 matches to inspect
        $line | Out-File -FilePath "c:\Users\Joy\Desktop\à¹‚à¸„à¸£à¸‡à¸‡à¸²à¸™à¸ˆà¸£à¸´à¸‡à¹€à¹€à¸—à¹‰\scratch\match_$i.json" -Encoding utf8
        $matchCount++
        if ($matchCount -gt 5) { break }
    }
}
